Our services

Let’s get you back in the flow

One call covers the whole list — emergencies, repairs, installations, and the leak detection work we are known for.

Leak Detection

A hidden leak quietly damages slabs, walls, and floors. We pinpoint leaks precisely — and document findings with photos and video when you need them for insurance.

  • Slab & in-wall leak location
  • Photo & video documentation
  • Water damage insurance claim support

Drain Cleaning & Pipe Repair

Slow drains, repeat clogs, and aging pipes handled properly — cleaned, repaired, or re-routed so the problem stays fixed instead of coming back next month.

  • Drain cleaning & clearing
  • Pipe repair & re-routing
  • Video / camera inspection

Water Heaters

No hot water, a leaking tank, or an upgrade on your mind? We repair and install water heaters — including modern tankless systems — sized right for your home.

  • Water heater repair
  • Tank & tankless installation
  • Honest replace-vs-repair advice

Installations & Repairs

The everyday plumbing list, done carefully: faucets, sinks, toilets, showers, disposals, gas lines, and water filters — installed cleanly and tested before we leave.

  • Faucets, sinks & toilets
  • Bathtub & shower installation
  • Gas line & water filter services

Video / Camera Inspection

Before anyone digs or guesses, we send a camera through the line. You see exactly what we see — the clog, the break, or the roots — so the repair targets the real problem the first time.

  • Sewer & drain line camera surveys
  • Pinpoint breaks, roots & blockages
  • Recorded findings you can keep

Gas Line Services

Gas work leaves no room for shortcuts. We install, repair, and test gas lines for water heaters, stoves, and dryers — sized right, sealed tight, and checked before we leave.

  • New gas line installation
  • Leak checks & pressure testing
  • Appliance hookups, done to code
